items.html: It thus follows that when the Mochin of Bina were repaired, the Mochin of Hochma were also repaired, with its thirty-two paths, when they are in Bina. And the indication of the repair of these thirty-two Elokim of the Mochin of Hochma, after their being in Bina, is the growth of the thirty-two teeth in the mouth of the infant, during the course of the time of nursing, as is seen by natural sense, for they begin to grow, and at the completion of the two years of nursing their growth is finished. And indeed, the fact of their growth being in the two years of nursing, which are twenty-four months, will be divided in the following manner.
